note: This is NOT an owner decision. It records the architecture hypothesis the v2 simulator was built to investigate. It does not amend A1-A7; A5 remains the historical record of the RF -> Hall pre-ionization proposal reference.
hypothesis: RF atmospheric propulsion as the nominal branch, with an independent Hall branch (Xe boost / special conditions) installed in parallel (RF || Hall), to be compared against rf_only and hall_only on the same atmosphere, mass-flow accounting, power boundary (bus_power_boundary_v2), mass boundary (mass_bom_v2) and mission environment.
questions: Can RF atmospheric propulsion independently cover the normal VLEO mission?
If yes, what additional mission coverage does Hall provide?
Is that incremental Hall benefit worth its mass, power, Xe and life cost?
no_winner_rule: the simulator returns FEASIBLE / INFEASIBLE / UNRESOLVED / OUT_OF_DOMAIN / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE and Pareto metrics; no BEST_ARCHITECTURE without an owner-approved preregistered rule
evidence_rule: absolute RF thrust in a score-bearing evaluation only from measured Vyovrinda hardware or an ADMITTED RF map; the reduced RF model is never score-bearing; Hall transport closures stay subject to the credible-set admission (currently empty)
proposed_allocations_status: PROPOSED_ENGINEERING_ALLOCATION (1350/300/700/300/50 W; dry 28 kg / wet 35 kg); RFP hard limits separate
